fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-11-26 (evening, 17:40): Messages threatening harm were sent to the complainant following a disagreement over a minor road collision. Arun Prakash submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000194. Padmini Raj was mentioned as a person who was present nearby, but no contact number was available. A further person, Tamilarasan Selvam, a driver, using the number 9000000305, is stated to be associated with the incident. A person named Kannan Shankar, associated with the number 9000000415, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Threatening messages allegedly sent after a dispute.
